title: Derived pullback preserves open support
statement: Let d, t and o be the ordinary or vertical pro-etale geometric and operation data [def-sf-open-normalization-data]. For every object M of the derived category of the restricted coefficient ring on U, Lg*(j! M) belongs to the essential image of j! from U prime. No natural transformation, normalization or identification of its value on restriction is included in the assertion.

source.place: Tags 04J0, 0E8I and the comparison of composite adjoints; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YY, 0G7E and 06YS. This open-support consequence is the unnormalized subargument of the parent proof.

proof.text: The localized site comparison identifies the two right-adjoint composite module functors. Conjugating through their composite adjunctions identifies pullback of open extension with extension of the corner pullback. The ring map is the actual restricted coefficient map.

Extension by zero preserves flat terms and K-flatness by its ordinary tensor projection formula and exactness. Resolve the open object and apply the ordinary comparison termwise. The flat-model comparisons for the given pullbacks give a derived isomorphism with an object in the essential image of the base-changed open extension.

The same argument takes place in the vertical diagram site, including all coefficient transitions. Compatible changes of left adjoint and left-derived presentations preserve the exhibited essential-image membership.
